name: Metro Brands Limited
summary: Metro Brands Limited is a leading footwear retailer in India selling shoes for men, women and children. It offers its own brands, including Metro, Mochi, Walkway and Da Vinchi, together with third-party names such as Crocs, Skechers, Clarks and Fitflop, plus accessories and shoe-care products. Sales run through stores, distribution channels and online platforms.
